logline: After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.

CLIP: episode 14, 1 segment(s), 25s
[00:00.50-00:05.50] ACTION: Juliana's blood-streaked, mud-caked hand slowly uncurls amidst the thorns, revealing the ornate emerald signet ring resting in her palm.
[00:01.00-00:05.50] SOUND: Eerie cold wind whistling over the briars with deep, atmospheric cello chords.
[00:05.60-00:09.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana stepping out from the briar patch, her cloak torn, cheeks scratched, holding the ring outward with unwavering resolve.
[00:07.70-00:09.00] JULIANA (Exhausted, Resolute): "I found it."
[00:09.50-00:13.50] CAMERA: Wide shot of Juliana holding the ring out toward the austere Police Constable standing guard beside the frozen garden.
[00:10.50-00:12.70] JULIANA (Firm, Commanding): "Now release my husband."
[00:12.50-00:13.50] ACTION: The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.
[00:13.50-00:15.50] CAMERA: Tight shot on the iron shackles locking Alexander's wrists together against the thorny backdrop.
[00:14.20-00:15.40] SOUND: Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.
[00:14.50-00:15.60] ACTION: The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.
[00:15.60-00:18.50] CAMERA: Tracking shot as Alexander lunges forward without hesitation, rushing past the Constable straight to Juliana.
[00:16.80-00:18.00] ALEXANDER (Gasping, Urgent): "Juliana."
[00:18.50-00:23.00] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's rugged hands tenderly grasping Juliana's bloodied, lacerated hands, turning them over with immense care.
[00:18.80-00:23.00] ACTION: Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.
[00:23.00-00:25.25] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's agonized, furious expression as he stares at her wounds.
[00:23.10-00:25.00] ALEXANDER (Trembling, Heartbroken): "What have they done to you?"
